summary: Full backend + frontend regression for FITUR EXTENDED 'Bukti Pembayaran' (12-field OCR + 'Rincian Transaksi' + Preview 58mm terpisah). BACKEND (pytest 5/5 PASS on /app/backend/tests/test_ocr_bukti.py, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/ocr_bukti_results.xml): (a) POST /api/ocr/bukti with synthetic PNG containing 'SeaBank / Berhasil / Rp51.000 / Dari Bagos Sudjiwo / SeaBank 901461530896 / Ke Shopee / Username: sudjiwo14 / No. Transaksi 2026082243508309274936490 / No. Referensi 15665380490586757524 / Metode SeaBank Bayar Instan / Produk Pembayaran Shopee / 22 Agu 2026 21:55' returns fields with amount.value===51000 (integer, confident=true), sender_bank contains 'seabank', sender_account contains '901461530896', recipient='Shopee', recipient_username='sudjiwo14', method contains 'seabank', ref='15665380490586757524', txno='2026082243508309274936490', product contains 'shopee', date contains '2026', time='21:55'. All 12 fields present with {value, confident} envelope. (b) OCR 'jangan menebak' — a deliberately partial image ('GoPay' + 'Dari Budi') yields amount/ref/txno/time/product/recipient_username with value=null AND confident=false. (c) Empty image_base64 → HTTP 400. (d) POST /api/sync/push with new-schema bukti [{id:'bx', doc:{status:'BERHASIL', amount:51000, sender_bank:'SeaBank', recipient:'Shopee', ...}, updated_at:1755800000000}] under store='TEST-OCR-<ts>' + subsequent GET /api/sync/pull?store=...&since=0 returns 'bukti' key containing bx with all extended fields (status, sender_bank, recipient, amount) round-tripped intact. (e) LWW semantics on s_bukti: newer updated_at retained, older push ignored (verified). Rincian card (top) live-updates with Dari/Ke rows and all detail rows. (4) Status dropdown [bukti-status] → OptionSheet Modal opens → selected [opt-BERHASIL] → status='BERHASIL'. (5) CETAK STRUK [bukti-print] → persists to localdb → router.push('/preview-struk?id=<id>') → header title 'Preview Struk 58mm' + BuktiReceipt58 renders with BUKTI PEMBAYARAN, TOKO BAGUS, STATUS BERHASIL, NOMINAL Rp51.000, DARI Bagos Sudjiwo, BANK SeaBank, NO. TUJUAN 901461530896, KE Shopee, USERNAME sudjiwo14, METODE, NO. REFERENSI, NO. TRANSAKSI, PRODUK, TANGGAL 22 Agu 2026, WAKTU 21:55, TERIMA KASIH TOKO BAGUS — all verified as text nodes. preview-share, preview-save-img, preview-print buttons all present + tappable. (7) Bukti card [riwayat-bukti-<id>] renders with badge 'BUKTI', method 'SeaBank Bayar Instan', 'Rp51.000', sender 'Bagos Sudjiwo', 'Ketuk: cetak ulang'. (8) Tap card → /baca-bukti?id=...&status=BERHASIL&amount=51000&sender_name=Bagos%20Sudjiwo&sender_bank=SeaBank&sender_account=901461530896&recipient=Shopee&recipient_username=sudjiwo14&method=SeaBank%20Bayar%20Instan&ref=...&txno=...&product=Pembayaran%20Shopee&date=22%20Agu%202026&time=21%3A55 with all inputs prefilled correctly (amount='51000', sender-name='Bagos Sudjiwo', method='SeaBank Bayar Instan', recipient='Shopee'). Consider migrating to the new File/Directory classes (File(uri).base64()) for future-proofing. Reference: /app/frontend/app/baca-bukti.tsx:11

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) OCR tests: PIL PNG with real DejaVu Sans glyphs + colored banner + border passes vision-model minimum-content heuristic. Helper _make_receipt_image is at /app/backend/tests/test_ocr_bukti.py:31. Follow /app/image_testing.md rules (PNG/JPEG base64, textured, non-uniform). 2) Frontend Playwright caveat: the Riwayat filter chip row is a horizontal ScrollView; 'Semua' chip sits off-screen at 390px. Dispatch PointerEvent (pointerdown/up + click) after scrollIntoView with block:'center', inline:'center'. Standard Playwright .click() often misses because RN-web Pressable uses onResponderRelease which fires on pointerup, not click. 3) The Miko mascot bubble (bottom-right) is a fixed-position overlay that intercepts clicks near CETAK STRUK/SIMPAN buttons; use dispatched PointerEvent, NOT page.click(force=True), to hit those buttons reliably. 4) After bukti-save, router.replace('/') triggers navigation to Transaksi tab. Web preview's localdb is IN-MEMORY only. Do NOT use page.reload() or page.goto() between save and Riwayat verification — use `window.history.pushState('/riwayat'); dispatch popstate` to preserve state. 5) Nav to Riwayat via `page.get_by_text('Riwayat')` clashes with the toast 'Bukti tersimpan di Riwayat' text; prefer clicking the tab-bar <a href='/riwayat'> anchor via evaluate. 6) Bukti card testID is dynamic (riwayat-bukti-<id>); enumerate via querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="riwayat-bukti-"]') and exclude 'riwayat-bukti-scan' + 'riwayat-bukti-hint'. 7) Long-press → Alert.alert delete is native-only; on RN-web it maps to a Modal that doesn't reliably trigger under Playwright pointerdown+setTimeout+pointerup — verify handler wiring in code, skip functional test. 8) Backend /api/ocr/bukti uses Gemini 3 Flash via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — response takes ~2-8s per call; give pytest.mark.timeout(120).
rca_of_issue: No production bugs found. Note during my run: initial attempt at page.click('[data-testid="bukti-print"]', force=True) did not trigger navigation to /preview-struk on RN-web preview — the click event fired but the Pressable's onPress (which listens on onResponderRelease via pointerup) did not fire. Root cause was NOT a bug: RN-web Pressable in @gorhom/bottom-sheet + react-native-web 0.20 requires actual PointerEvent (pointerdown + pointerup) to trigger onPress; MouseEvent alone is insufficient. Resolution: dispatch PointerEvent('pointerdown') + PointerEvent('pointerup') + MouseEvent('click') → onPress fires reliably. Real users on mobile/tablet fire native touch events which include pointerdown/pointerup, so no user-facing issue exists. This matches the RCA in iteration_18.json.
